title: Memory Leak with Amplification in µD3TN BPv6 EID Reference Handling allows Unauthenticated Remote Attacker to Cause…
description: A memory leak vulnerability exists in µD3TN BPv6 EID reference handling that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause a denial of service (DoS) condition. The flaw involves amplification of the memory leak, which can exhaust system resources and disrupt service availability.
